[Al Hayat Pharmaceuticals LLC SP](https://alhayatuae.com/) is a major private medical and pharmaceutical distribution company founded in 1982. Headquartered in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates, it supplies medicines, laboratory gear, and hospital equipment sourced from global manufacturers to local hospitals, pharmacies, and institutions. [](https://alhayatuae.com/)

- **Pharmaceuticals:** Distributing prescribed medicines and clinical drugs.

- **Medical & Projects:** Supplying hospital hardware and managing turnkey medical facility setups.

- **Laboratory & Dental:** Delivering specialized testing reagents, diagnostic tools, and dental consumables.

### Company Profile

- **Founded:** 1982

- **Headquarters:** Sharjah, UAE (with extra branches in Dubai and Abu Dhabi)

- **Clients:** Public and private hospitals, UAE government bodies, police medical centers, and universities [](https://alhayatuae.com/)
